title: 星図を運ぶ空飛ぶ船と、忘れものを探す街
author: 小鳥遊 ひなた

en.title: The Flying Ship That Carries Star Charts and the Town That Seeks Forgotten Things
en.premise: In a small repair shop tucked away in a corner of the town lives an elderly craftsman who lovingly restores old tools. One day, a mysterious airship slowly descends from the sky, carrying a star chart that records the journey of the stars. As the ship drops a single old star chart, the townspeople’s cherished memories begin to gently intertwine, connecting them in unexpected ways.

zh.title: 携星图的飞船与寻找遗失之物的城镇
zh.premise: 在城镇的一隅，有一家小小的修理店，住着一位老人，他细心地修复着古旧的工具。一天，一艘神秘的飞船从天空缓缓降落，携带着记录星辰轨迹的星图。船把一张旧星图遗落在地后，城镇里的人们珍藏的回忆开始温柔地交织在一起，彼此相连。
